etymology.historical_story: Upham is documented as the surname of Charles Upham, a New Zealand soldier awarded the Victoria Cross twice for actions in Crete and Egypt during the Second World War. This supplies a reliable cultural reference for the name, but does not establish the origin of the surname or identify the referent of the lowercase input. [新西兰文化与遗产部：Charles Upham](https://nzhistory.govt.nz/people/charles-upham)
